treaty_name: Convention between the United Kingdom and the Federal Republic of Germany for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2010, as amended 2014 and 2021)
eif_quote: The Double Taxation Convention entered into force on 30 December 2010 and is effective in Germany from 1 January 2011 and in the UK from: 1 April 2011 for Corporation Tax 6 April 2011 for Income Tax and Capital Gains Tax
source_title: 2010 UK-Germany Double Taxation Convention as amended by the 2021 Protocol — gov.uk consolidated text

rates.quote: a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
c) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.
Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Art. 32(2): effective in Germany for WHT on amounts paid on or after 1 January 2011; UK from 6 April 2011 (income tax) / 1 April 2011 (corporation tax); valid_from = later date. Rates unchanged by the 2014 and 2021 Protocols (2021 Protocol deleted the main-purpose paragraphs 10(6), 11(5), 12(5) and inserted PPT Art. 30A, in force 17 December 2021, effective 1 January 2022 for WHT). Dividends: 10% for pension schemes (Art. 10(2)(b)). Protocol para. 2: dividends and interest from profit-participating rights/debt (stille Gesellschaft, partiarisches Darlehen, Gewinnobligationen) deductible for the debtor may be taxed at source under domestic law without treaty limit. Not covered by the MLI.
